steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each request is placed by its stated priority.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Urgent request with no reason
findings.fix: Give the reason or lower the priority

findings.title: Request with no owner
findings.fix: Assign an owner and a deadline

findings.title: No ask recorded
findings.fix: Write the ask in one sentence

outcome.notChecked: Whether the request is worth doing.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

[medium] req-p-5.md:19  Request with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner and a deadline.

pros: Checks a request with no ask, an urgent request with no reason, and a request with no owner.
cons: Not checked: Whether the request is worth doing.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-pm-triage skill on the records for this review.
